column3: NASB renders “of shame” as “because of shame,” “falsifying” as “adulterating,” and “before God” as “in the sight of God.”
NASB follows the critical text without “to them”; “age” is rendered “world,” and “the illumination … beam forth” is “they might not see the light.”
NASB reads “Christ Jesus,” the order of other manuscripts; the critical text has “Jesus Christ.” “Servants” is rendered “bond-servants.”
NASB follows the critical text (“will shine”) and has “Christ” without “Jesus,” following manuscripts that lack it; “radiance” is rendered “light.”
NASB renders “the surpassingness” as “the surpassing greatness.”
NASB follows the critical text without “the Lord”; “death” is rendered “dying.”
The quotation is in capitals. Stray spacing around the quotation marks appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text (“with Jesus”).
NASB restructures the verse, adding “people” and “cause.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “being brought to decay” as “decaying” and adds “man.”
NASB renders “far surpassing to excessiveness” as “far beyond all comparison” and reorders the verse.
